answer: One concrete mechanism: measure round-trip latency on a two-stage stale-proof challenge. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The canyon of work and the shale of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a walnut to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
